design_scope: Fit/tune full1203 sparse exact-manual-anchor protocol; full test and class-holdout correctness remain closed; no full tune outcomes used to choose this design
experimental_unit: source group; videos, GT trajectories, predicted tracks, observations and pairs are repeated observations, not independent replicates

mean_control.target: Eligible emitted-label error; no GT/category/identity predictor
mean_control.hierarchy: Equal source -> equal eligible official GT trajectory -> equal observation; recompute for each training subset
mean_control.selection: 5 deterministic source-group outer folds; 3 inner folds per outer train; select concatenated inner OOF hierarchical Brier. Candidates within 1e-5 of minimum use declared grid order.
mean_control.ridge: Weighted mean BCE + .5*lambda*||beta_features||^2; train-only weighted standardization; unpenalized intercept

HGB.sample_weight: n_train * hierarchy_weights; l2 uses that scale

mean_control.calibrator: Fixed Platt on selected candidate's inner OOF predictions, weighted BCE + .5*1e-4*(intercept^2+(slope-1)^2); intercept [-20,20], slope [0,10]. Refit base on whole training subset. Outer/tune outcomes never calibrate their own predictions.
mean_control.primary: B3_nested_Platt; always report raw B2 too, never choose between them on outer/tune
mean_control.final: All-fit 3 inner source-group folds choose candidate and fit OOF calibrator; refit all fit, then predict tune once

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on frozen predictions; no model refit or training-uncertainty claim

mean_control.gate: Hard mean-risk control only. Does not qualify wrong-evidence vector centering, pair-dependence prediction, final tracking efficacy or novelty.
mean_control.primary_selection_metric: source_trajectory_observation_weighted Brier of concatenated inner OOF predictions

Platt.outcome_data: selected candidate inner OOF predictions and training-subset labels only; no outer/tune labels
Platt.constant_predictor: identity-centered penalty resolves nonidentifiable raw base slope; do not claim joint calibration slope identifiable on constant predictions

pair_design.primary_claim: P5 is a semantic-posterior misspecification diagnostic only. A deployable candidate must predict the Y-conditional wrong-evidence moment and beat matched quality/agreement and shared-label calibration controls; this is statistical conditional prediction, not automatic causal covariance or novelty.
pair_design.hard_mean_gate: B3 hard-error calibration does not establish E[W|V], class-direction calibration or valid centering

fit_roles.rule: On all selected fit source groups, block by source_group.split("/")[0]; SHA256(pair_role_v1+NUL+group) sort within block, alternate mean_role then pair_role. Assignment uses sealed metadata only, before support outcomes. Do not reassign a group lacking legal targets.
fit_roles.nuisance_role: mean_role: train/fix quality, direct W mean, shared candidate calibrators; three source-group diagnostic folds inside this role only
fit_roles.pair_role: pair_role: 5 outer x 3 inner source-group CV for pair heads with fixed disjoint nuisance models; no label from these groups may affect nuisance parameters, hyperparameters, calibration or target centering
fit_roles.tune: Nuisance models remain trained on mean_role; pair heads refit on pair_role; evaluate tune once after all decisions frozen
fit_roles.reason: Avoid global OOF nuisance targets whose training/selection uses a pair-validation group; no nested residual-table leakage
fit_roles.reverse_roles: Prespecified secondary robustness run, not a source of model/hyperparameter selection; report both directions if executed

edge_protocol.rank: SHA256(pair_edges_v1|video_id|local_track_id|min_observation_id|max_observation_id); retain smallest hashes in each lag bin
edge_protocol.supervision_after_edge_seal: Retain only endpoints independently eligible under fit-category/manual-source/class-blind matching AND same official GT identity; never whole-track oracle purity masks
edge_protocol.weights: Equal source group -> equal eligible official GT trajectory -> equal retained edge inside trajectory; recompute in every pair-training/evaluation subset
edge_protocol.no_supported_edge: quality-only fallback, not a zero/error/negative training example
edge_protocol.reference: All other emitted observations from this predicted track, excluding both endpoints; no GT filtering or pseudo-label correctness test; pool arithmetic means of foreground-normalized fused/text/image probabilities
edge_protocol.time: Offline sparse timeline only; memo50 and lag bins count sampled steps, not seconds

context.Q: For u_i,u_j = frozen 14 quality features: (u_i+u_j)/2, abs(u_i-u_j), u_i*u_j; frozen quality hard-risk mean/absdiff/product; emitted-label agreement; fused posterior dot/cosine/JS; reference entropy/top1/margin; log1p(number of references). No absolute class/source/video/track/GT inputs.
context.A: Q plus cosine(raw track embedding_i,raw track embedding_j), cosine(raw class embedding_i,raw class embedding_j), log1p(sample_step_lag), log1p(original_frame_index_lag). Do not use tracker-fused appearance as raw appearance.
context.same_conditioning: Direct W mean uses the full A context (or endpoint-oriented equivalent) and the same reference fields as the A pair head. Adding new inputs requires a new mean audit.
context.orientation: Endpoint mean uses own u then other u and shared symmetric A summaries; one shared function used for both endpoints
context.per_candidate_exclusion_for_direct_mean: Individual current p_i,c/p_j,c, GT-dependent coordinates, absolute class IDs and class embeddings are excluded from the primary direct-mean input. All 1203 coordinates still enter its loss and target trace.

direct_W_mean.W: W_i,c = p_i,c * 1[c != y], with p foreground-normalized and y used only in target
direct_W_mean.model: mu_i,c = sigmoid(alpha^T z_i) * sum_m softmax(B z_i)_m * basis_m,c; six basis weights and one mass head, shared over candidates/endpoints, no per-class parameters
direct_W_mean.objective: Hierarchical endpoint-context weighted sum_c (W_i,c-mu_i,c)**2 + 0.5*1e-3*penalized_parameter_L2; no Huber or top-k truncation
direct_W_mean.weights: Equal mean-role source -> equal eligible GT trajectory -> equal unique eligible endpoint -> equal retained contexts involving that endpoint

optimizer.method: L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient or identical autograd
optimizer.starts: two fixed starts: uniform mixture, and fused-reference dominated mixture; choose lower training objective only

direct_W_mean.efficient_loss: Cache 6x6 basis Gram, six dot(basis,W), ||W||^2 per endpoint-context; optimize from these sufficient statistics without materializing N*1203 trainable outputs
direct_W_mean.diagnostics: Three source-group OOF folds within mean_role; report residual mass and each L2-normalized basis projection by fixed mass bins, agreement and lag separately; calibration cannot be inferred from hard-error B3
direct_W_mean.support_rule_for_equivalence: For each predeclared marginal cell with >=10 source groups, source-bootstrap 95% interval must fit entirely in +/-0.02. A smaller or unsupported cell is inconclusive; never merge bins after observing outcomes.
direct_W_mean.calibration_interpretation: These are finite projection checks only. Passing does not prove the full vector conditional mean; failure forbids conditional-covariance language and triggers a specified richer mean study, not tune-driven model changes.

shared_candidate_calibration.single_view_control: Fit scalar fused temperature and class-shared loglinear text/image/fused calibrator by CE on mean_role only; candidate columns compete over all1203, no positive class-holdout label
shared_candidate_calibration.common_label_pi: pi_y = softmax_y(sum_b beta_b*(log p_i,b,y+log p_j,b,y) + sum_b gamma_b*log q_ref,b,y), b in fused,text,image; coefficients shared over all candidate classes
shared_candidate_calibration.optimizer: Six nonnegative coefficients in [0,10], CE + 0.5*1e-3*||theta-theta0||^2; theta0=[0.5,0,0,1,0,0] in fused/text/image endpoint then reference order; L-BFGS-B maxiter300; fixed prior, no pair-role/tune optimization
shared_candidate_calibration.disclosure: This is supervised readout calibration with all columns as negative competitors. Class holdout means no positive target from that class; not detector-unseen and not an unseen softmax column.
shared_candidate_calibration.plug_in_mu: p_i*(1-pi_single) is calibration control only; same-identity coordinate residual products are forced nonnegative

common_label_null.identity: Under conditional endpoint p independence given V, shared unknown Y already produces diagonal covariance. If m_i,c=E[p_i,c|V] does not depend on Y and P(Y=c|V)=pi_c, latent-label trace=sum_c m_i,c*m_j,c*pi_c*(1-pi_c).
common_label_null.general_decomposition: Cov(W_i,W_j|V)=E_Y Cov(W_i,W_j|V,Y)+Cov_Y(E[W_i|V,Y],E[W_j|V,Y]); the second term can survive perfectly fitted coarsened means.
common_label_null.operational_G0: Given current observed p_i,p_j and learned common-label pi, G0=dot(p_i,p_j)-sum_c pi_c*p_i,c*p_j,c
common_label_null.purpose: Strong shared-label/semantic-calibration control with richer current-posterior access; not an estimate of appearance-caused dependence. A residual beyond a misspecified pi can still be label-posterior error.
common_label_null.exact_conditional_degeneracy: If pi=P(Y|p_i,p_j,V) and t0 is the exact integral over Y, E[t-t0|p_i,p_j,V]=0. Predictability of P5 implies misspecified pi/conditioning or finite-sample error. It is not evidence of view coupling and never by itself authorizes mechanism retraining.

pair_design.pair_target: t=dot(W_i-mu_i,W_j-mu_j), including both cross terms; scalar trace surrogate, not full covariance. Nuisance mu fixed from disjoint mean_role.

pair_head.kind: Weighted ridge on 128 frozen Gaussian random Fourier features plus intercept
pair_head.transform: Training-subset weighted standardization; zero-scale features mapped to0. RFF phi=sqrt(2/128)*cos(Z@Omega/sqrt(d)+b), Omega iid N(0,1), b iid Uniform(0,2pi), fixed seed20261023; intercept unpenalized.
pair_head.selection: 5 outer x3 inner source-group CV on pair_role; inner concatenated hierarchical weighted MSE; within1e-8 use largest ridge. Frozen nuisance models never use pair_role labels.
pair_head.target_clip: No target clipping. Prediction clipped to [-1,1] identically for all scalar trace controls; report unclipped MSE sensitivity too.
pair_head.same_capacity: Q-only and A heads each have exactly129 active trainable coefficients despite different fixed input maps. This controls parameter count and optimization budget, not universal approximation power.

falsification.label_conditional_teacher_forcing: Oracle diagnostic only: refit the same six-basis direct-mean family on mean_role with extra GT-free-reference-at-y features q_ref,y and normalized rank(q_ref,y), exclude basis coordinate c=y and renormalize remaining bases; force mu_i,y=0. This conditions nuisance on known shared y without absolute class parameters. Fit/evaluate a separate same-capacity Q/A pair comparison on t_oracle; oracle y never enters deployable models or selects their hyperparameters.
falsification.teacher_forcing_interpretation: If primary apparent pair signal vanishes on this label-conditioned diagnostic, reject attribution to view coupling beyond common-label uncertainty. If oracle mean projection checks fail, result is inconclusive rather than an automatic rejection or pass.
falsification.split_reference: On the predeclared emitted-length>=6 subset only, hash-sort all nonendpoint reference observations and split alternately into A/B, each>=2; nuisance endpoint_i uses referenceA and endpoint_j uses referenceB. Refit matching nuisance models on mean_role and repeat fixed Q/A comparison. Shared-reference noise can create apparent excess; failure rejects shared-reference-specific attribution.
falsification.shuffle_training: For pair_role training only, independently permute t-t0 labels within source_group x agreement strata, seed20261024. Evaluate only strata with>=2 training edges and report their coverage; compare candidate and shuffled fit on the same eligible evaluation scope. Never use heldout/tune labels to construct shuffle or strata.
falsification.ablation: Repeat P5 with appearance features removed, then time features removed, retaining RFF128/129 coefficients and same search budget. These are prespecified descriptive ablations, never a way to select a final model from tune.

decision.predictive_candidate: P5 can pass a diagnostic predictability comparison only; it never authorizes novelty/mechanism retraining. The conditional_moment_candidate statistical and operational rules govern whether to advance a small readout candidate.
decision.falsification_failure: If P2 gains but P5 does not, common-label/calibration structure explains the observed residual under this control. If P5 gains but C129 matches the conditional-moment candidate on raw G, classify P5 as semantic calibration correction and stop mechanism retraining. If Q/A matches relation or disjoint-reference/shuffled controls remove the effect, reject the corresponding relational interpretation.
decision.mechanism_label: A complete conditional-moment predictive pass supports only an incremental label-conditional wrong-evidence moment model. No novelty claim from P5 or average positivity; shared source/identity difficulty and conditional mean approximation remain alternative explanations.
decision.tune: One frozen evaluation of all declared comparators, no refit or threshold/lambda/model changes. A tune failure rejects advancement of this frozen candidate; a tune success is developmental confirmation, not a new untouched test.
decision.deferred: Generic attention/learned log-pool and authentic correlated-fusion comparison remain required before downstream efficacy/novelty claims. Statistical scalar gates are not those completed comparisons.

evaluation.primary: source -> official GT trajectory -> retained edge weighted MSE
secondary: signed target mean and prediction mean

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on frozen nuisance and pair predictions; no refitting and no training-uncertainty or independent-pair claim

evaluation.final_null_comparison: Do not select best comparator on tune; report all declared differences

same_capacity_label_CE_control.name: C129_shared_label_CE
same_capacity_label_CE_control.training_role: pair_role, the identical 5 outer x3 inner source-group folds and edge weights used for pair regression; nuisance baseline pi remains fixed from mean_role
same_capacity_label_CE_control.candidate_token_fields: six scaled log scores: symmetric sum of endpoint fused/text/image log probabilities (3), reference fused/text/image log probabilities (3); use eps1e-8 and divide logs by log(1203). Plus three foreground normalized reference ranks.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.context20: 14 endpoint-averaged quality features, emitted-label agreement, fused endpoint JS, two raw appearance cosines, log1p(sample lag), log1p(original-frame lag); training-only weighted standardization
same_capacity_label_CE_control.score: 126 coefficients for six candidate log-score fields times [1,context20], plus three coefficients for reference ranks; same 129 coefficients for every candidate, no per-class bias or absolute class embedding. Add fixed mean-role baseline log(pi0) as offset.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.fit: Full1203 CE +0.5*lambda*||theta||^2; convex loglinear correction, L-BFGS-B maxiter100, gtol1e-6; no intercept common to all classes (would cancel). Coefficients initialized0. Candidate probability/GT category only used in CE supervision.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.selection: Inner OOF weighted MSE of implied G_C=dot(p_i,p_j)-sum_c pi_C,c*p_i,c*p_j,c vs observed G; within1e-8 largest lambda. Same six-candidate tuning budget as pair RFF. Also report weighted CE and hard-risk calibration.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.comparison: Evaluate G_C against the operational Y-conditional candidate on the SAME raw G target, source groups and frozen edges. No comparison of MSEs for different targets.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.implementation: Stream candidate logits in bounded batches and exploit six-field x21-context factorization; never materialize edges x1203 x129.
same_capacity_label_CE_control.meaning: Strong supervised semantic calibration competitor. Any remaining gain can still reflect finite calibration capacity, not prove intrinsic view dependence.

conditional_moment_candidate.target_mean: mu_i^y=E[W_i|A,Y=y]; query the shared six-basis mean with q_ref_fused,y and its normalized reference rank as two additional scalar features; set coordinate y to0, normalize each remaining basis with denominator max(1-Q_m,y,1e-8). Identical shared function for endpoints. Actual y used only in supervised training/diagnostic query.
conditional_moment_candidate.training_target: t_Y=(W_i-mu_i^Y) dot (W_j-mu_j^Y), nuisances trained exclusively on mean_role. This removes the between-Y covariance term when label-conditional means are correct; mean projection checks remain mandatory.
conditional_moment_candidate.class_shared_pair_head: 129-parameter RFF128+intercept ridge predicting d(A,y)=E[t_Y|A,Y=y]. Per-candidate inputs are A plus q_ref_fused,y and normalized reference rank_y. No individual current p_i,y or p_j,y; no absolute category or true label supplied at deployment.
conditional_moment_candidate.matched_QA_head: Identical RFF128/129 coefficients/ridge grid/folds, use Q plus the same candidate q_ref_y/rank_y. Exact all-candidate query function, trained at known eligible Y only.
conditional_moment_candidate.inference: For each of all1203 candidate y, compute shared mu_i^y, mu_j^y, d(A,y), then D_cond=sum_y pi0_y*d(A,y) and G_cond=sum_y pi0_y*(dot(mu_i^y,mu_j^y)+d(A,y)). pi0 is the frozen mean-role reference/current-posterior shared-label calibrator. No GT y is read at inference.
baselines: G_indY=sum_y pi0_y*dot(mu_i^y,mu_j^y), conditional-independence given Y reference
G_QA with the matched Q-query head instead of A-query head
G_C from C129_shared_label_CE, same raw G target
conditional_moment_candidate.cost: No1203x1203 tensor: each y-conditional basis Gram=(Gram_mn-Q_m,y*Q_n,y)/((1-Q_m,y)*(1-Q_n,y)); shared mean only6 mixture weights+mass per y. Exact integration costs O(K*(36+128)) per edge, K=1203; stream <=256 edges per batch. All candidate mass retained; top-k without an explicit exact tail is forbidden.
conditional_moment_candidate.statistical_primary: On pair-role outer OOF, A-query head vs Q-query head MSE for observed t_Y; source/GT-trajectory weighted and paired source bootstrap. Also report zero prediction and negative moment support. A positive average alone never passes.
conditional_moment_candidate.operational_primary: On same outer OOF groups, compare G_cond vs BOTH G_QA and G_C on observed raw G; require >=5% lower weighted MSE and source-bootstrap95% upper CI of each difference<0. Mean difference must remain<0 when deleting any single source group. The five-percent threshold is a predeclared practical effect choice, not power or independence evidence.
conditional_moment_candidate.advance_rule: Only this joint conditional-target plus operational-control pass can justify a small frozen candidate readout experiment. P5 predictability alone cannot. If C129 matches/beats G_cond, do not proceed to mechanism retraining or rename the P5 correction as a new method.
conditional_moment_candidate.interpretation_limits: Oracle Y at supervised training is legitimate label conditioning; integration over uncertain pi0 at deployment remains a model assumption. Shared semantic/identity difficulty and mean misspecification remain possible; this is not appearance-caused covariance or a covariance inverse.
conditional_moment_candidate.test_scope: No test or class-holdout correctness opened; fit-role only optimization, tune once after frozen models. Positive supervision is restricted to readout-fit labels.

synthetic_before_real_pair: Independent endpoints plus shared Bernoulli label produce positive ideal-centered wrong-evidence trace; label-conditional centering removes it
Operational_G0/t0 equals exact finite sum over Y; use full cross terms
Perfect pi implies zero expected excess t-t0 conditional on observed p, so a nonzero predictive correction may diagnose pi misspecification
Disjoint source-role and outer-label mutation cannot change the validation nuisance/selected model/prediction
Class permutation equivariance, endpoint swap symmetry, no endpoint inside reference, closed heldout/test inputs

runtime_estimate.scope: Estimates before full supervised support is opened; count matched rows/selected edges first and time a fit-only benchmark without changing the frozen model grid
runtime_estimate.mean_CPU: 2-20min after feature extraction for <=39903 fit and4557 tune manual-anchor upper bounds, 198 base candidate fits plus fixed-lambda controls; 1 CPU thread, no GPU
runtime_estimate.pair_CPU: For<=50000 legal retained edges: basic fixed-basis nuisance+scalar RFF diagnostics approximately15-60min; full C129 nested CE and exact all1203 Y-conditional integration may add30-180min on1 CPU thread. Benchmark one FIT-only candidate before scheduling all folds; if projected run exceeds3h CPU, record resource stop and optimize caching without changing data/hypotheses or claiming completion. No GPU allocation assumed.
runtime_estimate.storage: Sufficient-statistic basis Gram caches, GT-free per-track posterior sums, bounded candidate-logit batches. Approximate all-raw branch posterior payload is9.8GB float32 for681602x3x1204; do not duplicate it per fold or materialize pairx1203x129.

immutable_inputs.full_support: Pending independent full support audit; bind exact receipt/hash before execution
